q3.method: Leave-one-seed-out inverse calibration. For each alpha and signal, the mean recovered cutoff is monotonised only when needed, then the recovered-to-planted curve is inverted with linear interpolation.

forward.method: Paired forward comparison in the raw quantity reported by m5_lib.knee.

q4.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over the eight Q1 calibration seeds and sixteen common-scene ladder seeds, using f/14 and f/18. The reported conservative uncertainty also carries Q3's residual calibration scatter once per quoted B.

reuse.new_code: Cacheable fine-grid synthesis with explicit library diffraction and pixel MTFs, Q1 surface calibration, paired ladder statistics, bootstrap uncertainty, and JSON/text reporting.

verdict.detail: The estimator can separate planted H2 from planted H3 after a frequency-, slope-, and signal-dependent correction, but its bias is statistically aperture-dependent. A single multiplicative correction does not preserve f_c*N, so the registered inverse falsification test is compromised.
verdict.headline: NO-GO: the ladder is not fit to run under Amendment 1.
